The two of you receive a letter from Vesna out of the blue: you've been invited to claim a "prize." But as to just what this "prize" is, she did not say...

#### Read the invitation letter

#### Read the invitation letter

#### Go to the Zapolyarny Palace

**Paimon:** Paimon did find it a bit weird when we were looking at the map just now... There's a prize waiting for us at Zapolyarny Palace of all places?

**Guard:** Halt. What business brings you to the palace?

**Paimon:** Uh... We're here to claim our prize?

**Guard:** P—Prize? Ah, yes, the commander did leave orders about this... You may head inside. I will announce your arrival at once.

**Paimon:** So the letter wasn't lying... But, who would dare hand out prizes here?

**Vesna:** Huh, I thought I made it quite obvious... Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, of course.

**Paimon:** Whaaa...!?

**Danica:** Please keep your voice down.

**Paimon:** It really is the Tsaritsa...

- **Traveler:** So, why was I called here?

**Vesna:** Ahem! Allow me to explain. Her Majesty the Tsaritsa is seeking a new adviser.

**Vesna:** Her Majesty issues many decrees. The ones regarding military and state affairs are executed by me and Danica respectively.

**Vesna:** However, for others, the government ministers might not be best-suited to address them, and mobilizing the military would be overkill. So, Her Majesty the Tsaritsa finds herself in need of a new adviser to carry them out.

**Vesna:** Her Majesty has two requirements. One, that this person be exceptional in terms of skill, and second, that they must be one of the masses, someone who answers to no faction.

**Vesna:** From what I've seen, there's no better person for the job than Traveler! What do you say, Your Majesty?

**Danica:** ...Your Majesty, with all due respect, I believe this matter requires further discussion.

**Vesna:** C'mon, Danica. You've seen what he's capable of. / C'mon, Danica. You've seen what she's capable of.

**Danica:** I'm not doubting Traveler's skills or background.

**Danica:** But, I have served by Her Majesty's side for many years. I know just how great a responsibility this is, and how much effort it requires.

**Danica:** Yet Traveler comes and goes as he pleases, and answers to no one. How can we be sure he will execute Her Majesty's orders without hesitation? / Yet Traveler comes and goes as she pleases, and answers to no one. How can we be sure she will execute Her Majesty's orders without hesitation?

**Vesna:** Loosen up, Danica. Listen, I know this is your way of warning him this job isn't going to be some walk in the park. / Loosen up, Danica. Listen, I know this is your way of warning her this job isn't going to be some walk in the park.

**Vesna:** But I don't think he'll pass up this opportunity. After all, becoming the Tsaritsa's special envoy comes with power most people can't even imagine! / But I don't think she'll pass up this opportunity. After all, becoming the Tsaritsa's special envoy comes with power most people can't even imagine!

**Danica:** And with that power comes great responsibility. I cannot picture him willing to become a vassal of the state, subservient to the Tsaritsa. / And with that power comes great responsibility. I cannot picture her willing to become a vassal of the state, subservient to the Tsaritsa.

**Vesna:** Well, I suppose it's up to the person in question, now isn't it? What do you say, Traveler?

**Paimon:** Uhhh...

- **Traveler:** If I may, Your Majesty... Before making a decision, I'd like to ask one question. What is the purpose of this particular kind of decree?

**Vesna:** That's... quite the question.

**Danica:** Those tasked with following orders have no place questioning the motives of those who give them...

**Anastasya:** It matters not. I understand his concern. / It matters not. I understand her concern.

**Anastasya:** To answer your question, I wish to understand this nation I'm supposed to... love.

**Paimon:** What does that mean?

**Anastasya:** I am this nation's leader. I am intimately familiar with its history, and I know every edict and decree currently in effect.

**Anastasya:** My ministers submit reports with precise information on nearly all matters of state, available for my review whenever I so choose.

**Anastasya:** But does that mean I truly understand this nation?

- **Traveler:** I'm not sure how to answer that...

**Anastasya:** I wish to look upon this nation from a new perspective, one that is not rooted in military or political affairs. A perspective that might help me understand this nation anew. I'm searching for a candidate to provide this new perspective.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Why not go out and see for yourself?

**Anastasya:** I am the Tsaritsa, the god that rules over the land of Cryo... It is no simple matter for me to go out and observe the lives of my people with my own eyes, or immerse myself in their daily triumphs and troubles. You understand that, I'm sure.

**Anastasya:** Given the present circumstances, I must remain where I am needed, where there is important work to be done. I cannot simply don the clothes of a commoner and head into town. Danica would never allow it.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Then, why not put your Harbingers up to the task?

**Anastasya:** There are those among them that are well-informed and close to the people. Yet, as ministers of the court, they would inevitably be influenced by their relationship with me as their sovereign, and the interests at stake.

**Anastasya:** Nor can I be seen to favor the opinion of one minister over those of the others. Yet another limitation of my throne.

##### Shared continuation

**Anastasya:** So, what say you?

- **Traveler:** ...I have no intention of becoming a servant of your court. But, if you'll let me... I'm more than happy to help as a friend.

**Anastasya:** ...Then, I would like to ask a question of you in return.

- **Traveler:** Of course.

**Anastasya:** In general, what do you get up to when traveling through other nations?

- **Traveler:** ...

- **Traveler:** You think back on your journey, splitting it into a series of stories to tell the Tsaritsa.

- **Traveler:** Every time you step into a new nation, you always seem to get embroiled in one fate-altering event after another.

- **Traveler:** But if that were all that your journey entailed, it would feel somewhat hollow. A story told to a friend deserves more warmth.

- **Traveler:** With that in mind, you go on to share a series of trivial, but amusing details as well.

- **Traveler:** After all, it's often the small moments that make a journey seem full, and the memories such a substantial part of your life.

**Anastasya:** ...That is your answer?

- **Traveler:** Yes.

**Anastasya:** I see. Then, I hope you will travel through my country in much the same manner. On that condition, I accept your proposal.

- **Traveler:** Then we have an agreement.

**Paimon:** Awesome! Things felt tense there for a second...

**Anastasya:** Chayka.

**Chayka:** Yes, Your Majesty.

**Anastasya:** Note this down. Since he does not wish to swear fealty to the court, he shall have the title of "Consultant." / Note this down. Since she does not wish to swear fealty to the court, she shall have the title of "Consultant."

**Anastasya:** From this day forth, Traveler shall be known as "Consultant to the Tsaritsa." He shall be given proof of his role as a special envoy, granting him the authority to execute the duties the position requires. / From this day forth, Traveler shall be known as "Consultant to the Tsaritsa." She shall be given proof of her role as a special envoy, granting her the authority to execute the duties the position requires.

**Anastasya:** You will be responsible for receiving him when he comes for an audience with me, and will arrange any resources he needs to carry out his official duties. / You will be responsible for receiving her when she comes for an audience with me, and will arrange any resources she needs to carry out her official duties.

**Chayka:** Yes, Your Majesty.

**Anastasya:** Chayka is my secretary. You may direct any and all future questions to her. Does that sound amenable?

- **Traveler:** Of course.

**Anastasya:** Then this matter is settled.

**Anastasya:** I have nothing to ask of you today.

**Danica:** This matter is of great importance to Her Majesty. I only ask that you do your best.

**Vesna:** Hehe, we're colleagues now! Looking forward to working together!

**Chayka:** Greetings. It is a pleasure to meet you. How may I assist you today?

**Anastasya:** I have nothing to ask of you today.

**Vesna:** Hehe, we're colleagues now! Looking forward to working together!

**Danica:** This matter is of great importance to Her Majesty. I only ask that you do your best.

**Anastasya:** I have nothing to ask of you today.
